title: ViMU: Benchmarking Video Metaphorical Understanding

prompt.location: Appendix (task prompts with 'Available evidence' / 'Available options' blocks; judge rubric in Appendix B)

claim.metric: rhetoric mechanism identification score (%), set-based scoring

data.source: ViMU dataset (588 videos, 2,352 questions; dataset link on the project page)

notes: Inputs are videos; the frame/audio sampling used for API models is not specified in the text read, which is the soft gap. n_items is the total question count (per-task counts not extracted). OE scores use an LLM judge.

resolution.plan: Appendix I defines only the scoring (set-based score, zero if any wrong option is selected); how videos were fed to API models (frame count, sampling, audio/transcript) is not stated, and the Project Page/GitHub/Dataset links are header icons whose URLs did not survive extraction. Recover the links from the PDF, take the frame/transcript packaging from the released evaluation code, run the RM questions (five options, multi-select) on o4-mini-2025-04-16 zero-shot via API, and compare the set-based RM score with 33.21 (Table 1).
resolution.approximation: Frame sampling follows the released code; OpenRouter vs direct API routing.
